subject: Renewal & capacity increase — procurement portal steps

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-08-02T09:12:00-04:00
Subject: Renewal & capacity increase — procurement portal steps

Hi John / Clearview procurement team,

Following our account check-in last week, Clearview's renewal is coming up and the customer is planning a capacity increase (approx +35% tokens/month) with a small term amendment. Attached is SOW_v2 (redlines applied) and a short procurement checklist.

High-level ask: can you confirm preferred billing flow and PO sequencing so we can align onboarding steps in your procurement portal? Options we typically support:
- Direct invoice (net30) to Clearview accounts payable
- AWS Marketplace invoicing (if you prefer Marketplace billing and procurement registry flow)

Proposed sequence we suggest:
1) Vendor onboarding refresh in your procurement portal (we provide vendor details + compliance artifacts).
2) Sign the SOW amendment (DocuSign link included once you confirm).
3) Purchase order (PO) issued by Clearview, referencing deal ID CLV-2026-EXP-003.
4) Account capacity uplift scheduled to take effect on PO effective date.

Attachments: clearview_signed_SOW_v2.pdf, procurement_checklist.xlsx

Next steps — could you: 1) confirm whether Redwood is already in your vendor registry, 2) tell us preferred billing channel (Direct vs Marketplace), and 3) share the PO contact and expected PO number format?

Thanks — happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Best,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0134

I pasted your suggested sequence below for reference. If you can send step-by-step instructions for the procurement portal and a simple DocuSign amendment link, we can push this through our PO lane this week.

Avery / Laura — quick internal note before we reply:
- Marketplace: Redwood is listed in AWS Marketplace (vendor ID RW-832-AT). We can invoice via Marketplace for this account, but pricing needs to match the SOW line items exactly (procurement flagged a mapping concern previously).
- SOW redlines: Legal flagged the data logging/retention paragraph; we trimmed retention to 90 days for telemetry and added explicit non-prod shard language. See comments in clearview_signed_SOW_v2.pdf.
- Attachments for procurement: I’m attaching the procurement_checklist.xlsx we use for vendor portal onboarding (includes required invoice remittance details and contact fields).

Recommended internal approach:
1) Confirm marketplace acceptance with Clearview (John).
2) If marketplace is OK, supply vendor ID RW-832-AT and our marketplace billing instructions.
3) If they prefer direct invoice, finance will generate an invoice once PO is received (net30).

Avery — I'll prepare a brief note for John that includes the vendor ID and the checklist. Laura, FYI on the SOW edits in case procurement pushes back.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
To: John Sala <john.sala@clearviewhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-08-03T08:10:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Renewal & capacity increase — procurement portal steps

John — thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers below and next steps included.

1) Vendor registry: Redwood is listed in AWS Marketplace under vendor ID RW-832-AT. If you want Marketplace billing, please reference RW-832-AT when creating the PO.

2) Marketplace support: yes — we can process renewals and upsells via AWS Marketplace. Note: Marketplace invoices will show as AWS Marketplace purchases; the pricing must match the SOW lines (Ben noted mapping concerns). If Clearview wants line-level parity on an accounting invoice, direct invoice (net30) is also available.

3) SOW data clause: we incorporated Legal's trim to retention to 90 days for telemetry and added the non-prod shard sentence. See SOW_v2 where we highlighted the change. If you need exact language swap to match your standard vendor terms, we can accept a short addendum via DocuSign.

Procurement portal steps (minimal):
- Step A: Log into your procurement portal and start a new vendor refresh entry.
  Required fields: Vendor name (Redwood Inference), Vendor ID (RW-832-AT), Remit-to (see checklist), Contact (avery_johnson@redwood.com).
- Step B: Upload clearview_signed_SOW_v2.pdf and procurement_checklist.xlsx to the vendor record.
- Step C: Choose billing method (Marketplace vs Direct). If Marketplace, add AWS Marketplace order reference.
- Step D: Issue PO that references deal ID CLV-2026-EXP-003 and either "Marketplace Order" or "Direct Invoice" in the PO notes.

DocuSign amendment: https://www.docusign.net/overview?envelopeId=5a9b3c (one-click amendment for the SOW redline).

Next steps for us: once you confirm preferred billing method and provide PO number, Ben / Finance will process invoice or confirm marketplace mapping. We can schedule a short kickoff on Aug 10 to finalize the uplift timing.

Thanks,
Avery Johnson
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
avery_johnson@redwood.com
